# Focused source excerpts

`wine-variable-table-with-next-opener.bin` is the exact byte range
`[38624, 39773)` from `wine-glass.prt`, SHA256
`b8b10f46183f7ad3f0ff2eb4b42e228a5d5c4262d191610e995fdc96e0dd431e`.
It contains a count-72 `var_arr` with the seven named prototype fields and
six full-width `ed` coordinate/guess images. It includes the following
`eqtn_arr` opener as boundary context. The test checks stored fields and IEEE
bits; it does not establish isolated-table EOF grammar, units, solved
geometry, or feature ownership.

`ftc11-cross-section-terminal.bin` is the exact byte range
`[115829, 117670)` from `nist_ftc_11_asme1_rb_cr4050_ra.prt.1`, SHA256
`008bcf6a6b68798a8a15bcebe8cf53070ce25eb97ab3f6e7ded5dce21fd3139c`.
It contains one named curve prototype, fifteen positional rows, and the
physical `Xsections` terminal. Its parameter bodies remain opaque.

The separate golden fixture `authored_complete_variable_prototype.prt`
uses an authored empty-prototype form. It is a syntax boundary control,
not a representative real named prototype or an `ed` coverage claim.
`featdefs_sketch_variables.prt` retains its original malformed control.
Golden coverage floors count files; they do not measure format coverage.
